title: Correction a deductible absorbed
assertion: No entry: shown as payer corrected, balance the patient's, never recovered and never no change; a correction the deductible absorbed in part `approved` for what the payer paid; a higher allowed amount paying less with nothing approved recorded as decreased with no entry, and a later correction `approved` against the payment before it

files.description: The original payment: 97110 x 2 allowed 70.00 against an expected 100.00 (a case line), CO-45 80.00, PR-1 deductible 30.00, paid 40.00.
The adjusted remittance: the original reversed (PR-1 -30.00, paid -40.00) and the correction allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-1 deductible 60.00, paid 40.00: BPR02 0.00, no payment (H, NON).
A posting export with line detail: one row posting the correction’s 40.00 on its 2026-03-09 line, the payment it replaced.
The correction reversed alone (PR-1 -60.00, paid -40.00) beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 110.00.
Another patient's original payment (its own case line): allowed 70.00, CO-45 80.00, PR-1 deductible 50.00, paid 20.00.
Its adjusted remittance: the original reversed (paid -20.00) and the correction allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-1 deductible 70.00, paid 30.00: BPR02 10.00.
The bank export of that check: one deposit of 10.00.

A second reprocessing at the same allowed amount: the correction reversed (paid -30.00) and paid again allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-1 deductible 80.00, paid 20.00, beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 140.00.

From original.835, in a practice of its own: the original reversed (paid -40.00) and a correction allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-1 deductible 66.00, paid 34.00, beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 144.00.
That correction reversed (paid -34.00) and a later one allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-1 deductible 50.00, paid 50.00: BPR02 16.00.
